entry.author: Climate Change Commission
entry.summary:
We're engaging with the public about our work to update our 2024 advice on emissions budgets – and we'd like to hear from you. In this webinar, we discuss how we’re updating our analysis on Aotearoa New Zealand’s fourth emissions budget (2036–2040), due by 31 March 2027.

Sharing your evidence and insights is an opportunity to help inform our advice to the Government on what the level of ambition for the fourth emissions budget should be.

General Manager Robin Campbell and Project Director Rob Carr share the scope, response process, and the information and evidence we’re looking for, followed by Q&A.

Share your input and learn more here: https://haveyoursay.climatecommission.govt.nz/comms-and-engagement/eb4-update-2027
